task: Public decode compositing an alpha channel into a YCbCr/monochrome target (e.g. decoding any HEIC/AVIF-with-alpha to a YCbCr output); Op_flatten_alpha_plane allocates R/G/B planes with target depth 0, the dropped add_channel() error leaves plane ptrs null, and the composite loop writes through them -> null-pointer write. Single lib file libheif/color-conversion/alpha.cc (+8/-1, rest tests).
